Name: Cake Slice
Author: Arcticfez
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This is just a starter mod i made to learn how. i just decided to make a slice of cake.[/color]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]It is installed just like any other mod. First you download it here on Nexus Mods. Then in your download tab you unzip it. Then you move your unziped version into your mods folder.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Adds a new slice of cake.
Recipe:
1 Cherry.
1 Milk (any).
2 Eggs (Any),
2 Flour
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]For this mod you need both Smapi and Content Patcher. i used version 2.9.1 of Content Patcher, but it should be okay as long as it's 2.9.0 or above version.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Thanks to SiTheGreat1 for their guide and mod  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43811]Modder's Pie - A Complete Tutorial For Your First Mod[/url]. It is a great guide and helped me get started with making mods.[/color]
